def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    # Build index
    node_by_id = {}
    for n in nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        node_by_id[nid] = n
    # Build children mapping
    children = {nid: [] for nid in node_by_id}
    root_id = None
    for nid, n in node_by_id.items():
        parent = n['parent']
        if parent is None:
            root_id = nid
        else:
            children[parent].append(nid)
    # Initial retained set
    retained = set(node_by_id.keys())
    # Determine candidates: removable, not root, symbol not required
    candidates = []
    for nid, n in node_by_id.items():
        if n['removable'] and n['parent'] is not None and n['symbol'] not in required_symbols:
            candidates.append(nid)
    # Sort by depth desc, then id asc
    candidates.sort(key=lambda nid: (-node_by_id[nid]['depth'], nid))
    removed_order = []
    for nid in candidates:
        if nid not in retained:
            continue  # already removed (if parent removed?)
        # Check no retained children
        has_retained_child = any(cid in retained for cid in children[nid])
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # Check if all required symbols remain without this node
        # Compute symbol presence among retained minus this node
        # We can check if for each req_sym, there is some node in retained (excluding nid) with that symbol
        ok = True
        # Build set of symbols present in retained except nid
        symbols_present = set()
        for rid in retained:
            if rid == nid:
                continue
            symbols_present.add(node_by_id[rid]['symbol'])
        for req in required_symbols:
            if req not in symbols_present:
                ok = False
                break
        if ok:
            # Remove
            retained.remove(nid)
            removed_order.append(nid)
    # Sort retained ids
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed_order, "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted}
